title: 3 m rear extension, eaves 0.5 m above existing, rendered, in a National Landscape (1 Eastfield Drive, West Bradford)
basis: Ribble Valley BC ref 3/2025/0408, certificate of lawfulness refused, officer report signed 11 Jul 2025: single-storey rear extension 3 m deep on a semi-detached house in a National Landscape (article 2(3) land); eaves exceed the existing eaves by approximately 0.5 m (A.1(d)); also refused because it is to be rendered (A.2(a)), now tested as a second expectation. Only the 0.5 m difference and the 3 m depth are from the report: absolute roof heights are placeholders.
